description: Elements of the model as plain data, filtered and paged. Kinds: level, wall (start/end points, length, height, thickness, face area m², opening ids), slab, roof, stair, door, window (width, height, sill, host wall id, size limits), furniture (type, position, rotation, size, limits), room (area m², enclosed, tag). Outlines are summarised unless detail is "full". Every element has id, kind, name, level (the level's id) and properties (custom data).

property.description: Only elements with this custom property (set to this value)

selected.description: Only what the user has selected
